note: Generated from TECH-SPEC.md §15 on 2026-09-05. Only ready epics run; phase 2/3 epics stay draft until phase 1 ships. Edit with node agentic/scripts/backlog.mjs.

epics.title: Foundation: monorepo, tokens (Palette B), app shell, built-in auth (sessions + 2FA), tenancy + RLS, audit/outbox, --demo seed, four-locale i18n, terminology pass, gates, CI, Compose
outcomes: A developer clones the repo, runs pnpm setup && pnpm dev, and opens the demo ministry (with --demo) in uz-Latn, uz-Cyrl, ru and en
Every gate in agentic/gates.json runs green on the scaffold, including four-way i18n parity
Username/password login with server sessions works for the six demo accounts; TOTP 2FA can be enabled; the shell renders in light/dark at 1440/1024/390
Cross-tenant isolation test passes in CI
packages/i18n/TERMS.md records the real-world Uzbek/Russian terminology with sources

epics.title: People & Organisation: directory, positions/staffing table, org chart, privacy tiers, quarterly verification, delegation
outcomes: A specialist finds any colleague by Latin or Cyrillic name in under 3 seconds and sees work contacts
HR sees restricted fields with a logged purpose; a specialist cannot, even via list/search/export
The org chart shows vacancies as dashed boxes and units with mandates
A head sets a deputy for a date range; the deputy acts "on behalf of" in the audit log

epics.title: Work core: tasks and topshiriq, projects, list/board/timeline views, quick-add, filter grammar, saved views, comments, attachments, labels, checklists
outcomes: A head types "Nodira: EGDI dalillar paketi, juma" and a topshiriq for Nodira due Friday exists
The same tasks appear as list, board and timeline; drag on the board is keyboard-accessible
A filter string like assignee:@me due:<=friday is a shareable URL and a saved view
Comments with @mentions notify; attachments are virus-scanned before visible

epics.title: Rituals: Friday pulse, project health computation, Ijro nazorati escalation queue, unit objectives
outcomes: A project lead updates status + one sentence inline in under 20 seconds; history is visible
A missed deadline moves the item into the head's Ijro nazorati queue with acknowledge/reassign in place
Project health is computed from dates, pulses and escalations, never typed
3–5 quarterly objectives per department link to projects and show on Home

epics.title: Inbox & notifications: event bus, preferences, quiet hours, digests, email, ICS feeds
outcomes: Every notification shows why it was sent (assigned/mentioned/escalated/decision/digest)
No notification leaves the server between 20:00 and 08:00 or on weekends unless flagged blocking
A personal daily digest and a Friday department digest are generated by pg-boss jobs
A person subscribes to an ICS feed of their leave, events and deadlines

epics.title: Telegram bot: account link, nudges, one-tap approvals and RSVP, deep links, uz/ru/en templates
outcomes: A person links Telegram from Settings and receives a Friday 15:00 nudge listing projects needing a sentence
A head approves a leave request from an inline button; the app shows who decided and when
No message ever contains restricted data (allow-list serializer + build-time check)
Deep links open the exact record after login

epics.title: Requests: leave with balances and holiday calendar, business trips with order numbers, generic requests; concurrence then approval; inbox one-tap
outcomes: A specialist requests leave in three taps and sees the remaining balance before submitting
Weekends and the admin-editable 2026 holiday calendar are excluded from leave day counts
A trip request gets TRIP-2026-NNN and a concurrence step before final approval
A head approves from the inbox; the requester is notified within a minute

epics.title: Events & team building: events with RSVP/waitlist, capacity, checklist, budget, feedback, date polls, photos
outcomes: An organiser creates a futsal evening with capacity 20; the 21st RSVP goes to the waitlist automatically
RSVP works in one tap from the app or Telegram
A date poll picks the retreat date; the event checklist mirrors the reference (owner/budget, transport, capacity, accessibility, safety, feedback)
After the event, feedback is collected and visible to the organiser

epics.title: Pages editor: Tiptap, templates, mentions, assignable checklist items, version history
outcomes: A head writes a "how we work" page with / commands and @mentions; autosave shows Saqlandi
A checklist item in a page can be assigned with a due date and appears in that person's My work
Version history shows a diff and can restore
Pages older than 180 days without verification are marked stale

epics.title: Onboarding: templates, plans, items by role (newcomer/manager/HR/buddy/IT), buddy pairing, progress, 30/60/90 checkpoints
outcomes: HR starts a plan for a newcomer from a role template; tasks appear for the newcomer, manager, HR, buddy and IT
The newcomer sees Day 1 / Week 1 / 30 / 60 / 90 progress on Home and a reading list of pages
The manager gets 30/60/90 feedback prompts
A newcomer finds who to ask within 30 seconds without training

epics.title: Home & director brief, search (FTS + normalize_uz), My work, Waiting on
outcomes: Home answers due-from-me / needs-my-decision / around-me without a click for each persona
The director's Home is a one-page weekly brief composed from pulses with a human edit step
Search finds "Nodira", "Нодира", "Gʻ" and "G'" spellings
Waiting on lists items I assigned that are overdue or unreported

epics.title: AI level 1 on the self-hosted GLM: gateway, quick-add parsing, translate on demand (4 locales), pulse draft, catch-up, newcomer briefing, duplicate detection, tag suggestions, digest ranking
outcomes: Quick-add parses uz/ru/en into assignee/due/unit with a visible confirmation before saving
Any text can be translated on demand; official-register text shows a review hint
The Friday composer offers a drafted sentence from the week's activity; the human edits and saves
Every AI call goes to the in-country GLM endpoint only (routing test in CI) and is traced with cost; Uzbek/Russian quality passes the golden set before a feature is on by default

epics.title: Admin & tenant provisioning: settings, theme tokens, holidays, roles, audit viewer, API keys/webhooks
outcomes: An admin changes the tenant colour, logo and holiday calendar without a deploy
The audit viewer answers "who saw X's restricted fields" in one query
A new department tenant is provisioned by one form (Keycloak organisation + seed)
Webhooks deliver signed events with retries

epics.title: Hardening and release 1.0: accessibility, i18n QA, performance budgets, offline queue, error states, docs
outcomes: axe reports zero serious/critical on every route; keyboard walkthrough of all rituals recorded
Lighthouse ≥ 90 on the five main routes; shell under 200 kB gzip
Offline: reads work, writes queue with a pending badge, approvals refuse offline
Release 1.0 tagged with a plain-language changelog in uz/ru/en

epics.title: Telegram Mini App: inbox, approvals, pulse, RSVP, quick-add
outcomes: A head approves and a specialist RSVPs from the Mini App with initData validated server-side
Theme follows Telegram theme params; haptics on confirm

epics.title: Canvas: retro and brainstorm boards on Excalidraw, dot voting, timer, templates
outcomes: A unit runs a retro with sticky notes, anonymous dot voting and a visible timer
Retro action items become tasks

epics.title: AI level 2: semantic search, ask with citations, meeting notes to tasks, retro summary, onboarding plan drafting, similar projects
outcomes: Search returns semantically related items the user is allowed to see
Every generated answer cites its sources; a pasted meeting note becomes accept-per-item task drafts

epics.title: Team management extras: capacity view (person × week), 1:1 notes, kudos attached to work, birthdays, skills matrix
outcomes: A head sees overload before Friday in a person × week view
Kudos attach to a task or event; birthdays appear quietly on Home

epics.title: Calendar sync (CalDAV/Graph), web push, ICS subscriptions hardening
outcomes: Leave and events appear in Outlook/Google calendars
Web push works as an opt-in secondary channel

epics.title: Automations (5 triggers), recurring tasks, templates gallery
outcomes: A rule "when a card enters Done, archive after 3 days" runs without admin help
Recurring tasks and project templates cover the department's repeating work

epics.title: Multi-ministry operations: tenant provisioning UI, instance admin, backup/restore UI, k3s option
outcomes: A sysadmin in another ministry installs and provisions a tenant in an afternoon from the README
A restore drill is scripted and rehearsed

epics.title: State integrations: OneID broker, E-Imzo for official approvals (optional), ijro bridge (optional)
outcomes: Staff can log in via OneID where the ministry enables it

epics.title: AI level 3: bounded agent execution with preview and undo, anomaly flags on requests, aggregate workload signals
outcomes: "Move X's overdue items to next week and notify them" shows a preview, executes on confirm, and can be undone for 10 minutes

epics.title: Decision intelligence: delivery confidence trend, dependency alerts, forecasts
outcomes: Status trend per project shows movement, not only current state

epics.title: Cyrillic Uzbek locale via transliteration; EGDI observatory for Strategy & Rankings
outcomes: Older staff can switch to Cyrillic Uzbek; the observatory tracks UN EGDI methodology inputs
